claims.content: Enable the Business Owner to analyze auction business performance by viewing reports on current auctions status, sales, inventory performance, and customer activity through the Auction Admin Reporting system.

goal.raw_text: Enable the Business Owner to analyze auction business performance by viewing reports on current auctions status, sales, inventory performance, and customer activity through the Auction Admin Reporting system.

claims.content: Business Owner
The Business Owner is logged into the Auction Admin system.
The Business Owner is navigating from the Auction Admin Main Menu page.
The auction system database contains data for reporting.
The Business Owner selects a reporting option (such as Current Auctions Status, Sales Report, or Inventory Performance Report) from the Auction Admin Main Menu.

trigger.raw_text: The Business Owner selects a reporting option (such as Current Auctions Status, Sales Report, or Inventory Performance Report) from the Auction Admin Main Menu.

claims.content: The Business Owner selects a specific reporting option (e.g., Current Auctions Status, Sales Report, Inventory Performance) from the Auction Admin Main Menu.
If viewing the Current Auctions Status, the Business Owner chooses between hourly or daily view and filters by auction type (e.g., Jewelry, Gemstone, All).
For Sales or Inventory reports, the Business Owner configures parameters such as date ranges, retail categories, or product types using the available filters.
The Business Owner executes the report by clicking the 'Run' or 'Submit' button.
The system displays the generated report containing performance metrics (e.g., total bids, sales revenue, inventory aging) in a tabular format.

After selecting 'Current Auctions Status', the Business Owner can choose an alternative view by switching between 'Daily View' (showing future days' performance) and 'Hourly View' (showing today's performance broken down by hour).

When generating 'Sales Report' or 'Inventory Performance' reports, the Business Owner can take an alternative path by configuring specific filters such as Retail Category, Product Type, Material Type, Gemstone, Brand, and Date Range to narrow down the data before executing the report.

From the Auction Admin Main Menu, the Business Owner can branch into various alternative reporting paths including 'Customer Ranking Report', 'Auction Customer RFM Report', 'Competition Report', and 'Link to Omniture Reports', in addition to the standard status and sales reports.

The Business Owner has viewed a report displaying auction performance metrics such as closing date, total bids, total cost, number of closings scheduled, number of bidders, average cost per auction, number of bids, and average bids per item.

The Business Owner has viewed a sales report containing metrics including gross product value, return amount, net revenue, cost of goods sold (COGS), net COGS, gross margin percentage, average price, units sold, units returned, net units, unit return percentage, shipping revenue, and cash recovery percentage.

The Business Owner has successfully accessed one or more reporting options from the Auction Admin Main Menu, such as Current Auctions Status Report, Sales Report, Inventory Performance & Aging Report, Customer Ranking Report, Auction Customer RFM Report, Competition Report, or Link to Omniture Reports.
The system has displayed the generated report in a tabular format with configurable filters applied (e.g., retail category, product type, material type, gemstone, brand, date range).
